test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting on a circular bench, facing away from the centre but not necessarily in the same order. O and J are the neighbours of N. M is sitting to the immediate right of J. L is sitting third to the left of N. Who is sitting second to the right of M?
solution: Given: Six friends, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting on a circular bench, facing away from the center. 1) M is sitting to the immediate right of J. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eca7a08d9886ef8909339adfecb95d094def8f0ce17d0fd7efb3d960d27fdbe1.png] 2) O and J are the neighbours of N.
